title: Getting Started With Agents: Billing Agents in Business Central - Configure "Pay as You Go" (2025)

chapters.title: Setting up billing plan in Power Platform admin center

features.name: Pay-as-you-go billing for agents
features.description: Agent consumption is charged to an Azure subscription through a billing plan configured in Power Platform admin center. Allows continued agent execution after evaluation capacity is exhausted.
caveats: Consumption data may take up to 24 hours to propagate to monitoring pages

features.name: Agent consumption monitoring
features.description: Monitor agent message consumption in Power Platform admin center under Copilot Studio environments, and track costs via Azure resource group cost analysis.
caveats: Consumption reporting may take up to 24 hours to appear

features.name: Azure budget creation for agent spending
features.description: Create budgets in Azure resource group to control spending on pay-as-you-go agent messages during a specific period, with optional email alerts when approaching budget limits.

quotes.text: After some time, a banner may appear explaining that the evaluation capacity has been used up.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the problem being solved - free evaluation capacity for agents has a limit

quotes.text: You can enable more usage by setting up pay as you go billing for the agents consumption.
quotes.why_it_matters: States the core solution for extending agent usage beyond evaluation

quotes.text: Agent consumption will be charged to your Azure subscription.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies where billing charges are incurred - directly to customer's Azure subscription

quotes.text: Select the pay as you go with Azure option. Pick the billing policy or plan you have just created.
quotes.why_it_matters: Key configuration step linking the environment to the billing plan
